page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

Given the 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-frequency AMD EPYC processors, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage. It is suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, web serving, and CI/CD pipelines.
